steps.message: Transcribe the contents of video backup_episode_5_export.mp4 by watching it in VLC player (located in Download) and writing the sequence of strings shown on each frame to the text file backup_episode_5_export_transcription.txt in Markor as a comma separated list. For example, if the first frame shows the text "edna" and the second frame shows the text "pineapple", then the text file should contain only the following text: "edna, pineapple".
Execute: adb shell "ls -l /sdcard/Download; ls -l /storage/emulated/0/Download; command -v ffprobe; command -v ffmpeg; command -v mediainfo; command -v strings; command -v grep; command -v sed"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "ls -l /sdcard/Download; ls -l /storage/emulated/0/Download; command -v ffprobe; command -v ffmpeg; command -v mediainfo; command -v strings; command -v grep; command -v sed""
